title: Database Engineer – TEDRA
description:

Founded in 2015, our core philosophy is built around a strong product engineering mindset—ensuring every solution is architected and delivered right the first time. Today, Wissen Technology has a global footprint with 2000+ employees across offices in the US, UK, UAE, India, and Australia. Our commitment to excellence translates into delivering 2X impact compared to traditional service providers. How do we achieve this? Through a combination of deep domain knowledge, cutting-edge technology expertise, and a relentless focus on quality. We don't just meet expectations—we exceed them by ensuring faster time-to-market, reduced rework, and greater alignment with client objectives. We have a proven track record of building mission-critical systems across industries, including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more. Wissen stands apart through its unique delivery models. Our outcome-based projects ensure predictable costs and timelines, while our agile pods provide clients the flexibility to adapt to their evolving business needs. Wissen leverages its thought leadership and technology prowess to drive superior business outcomes. Our success is powered by top-tier talent. Our mission is clear: to be the partner of choice for building world-class custom products that deliver exceptional impact—the first time, every time.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Wissen Technology is hiring a Database Engineer for the TEDRA (Trade Enrichment Data Reporting & Allocations) platform. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale trade capture and reporting solutions supporting real-time and historical data processing within investment banking environments. The position offers hands-on opportunities in data engineering, ETL development, reporting optimization, and enterprise database performance tuning.
  
  
**EXPERIENCE, LOCATION, MODE OF WORK**
**Experience**
: 5-7 years
  
  
**Location**
: Mumbai
  
  
**Mode of Work**
: Hybrid
  
  
**Mandatory Skills (Must Have)**

* Strong relational database expertise with DB2, Sybase, and/or Greenplum (5+ years)
* Advanced SQL development, stored procedures, query optimization, and performance tuning
* Python programming for ETL automation, data processing, and reporting solutions
* ETL development experience using Informatica or similar enterprise ETL tools
* Unix/Linux and Shell/K-Shell scripting in production environments
* Database performance tuning including indexing, statistics analysis, and data modeling
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or QlikView

**Skills**
**Optional Skills (Good to Have)**

* Hadoop ecosystem and Spark processing
* Data mining and analytics experience
* Investment banking trade lifecycle knowledge
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience
* Java and messaging technologies exposure

* Education: BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
* Leadership: Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical workstreams
* Ownership: Ability to drive end-to-end feature delivery and production support responsibilities
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with globally distributed teams
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset and database troubleshooting skills

**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate business requirements into optimized SQL queries and reporting solutions
* Design, develop, and maintain database objects, ETL workflows, and automation scripts
* Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and capacity improvements
* Support trade capture data platforms for real-time and archival processing
* Collaborate with global stakeholders, business users, and technology teams
* Develop Python-based automation for data validation and operational processes
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives
* Provide production support and act as SPOC for user and reporting-related queries

title: Manager - IT Applications (Digital Solutions & Technical Project Management)
description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Manager – IT Applications (Digital Solutions & Technical Project Management) is responsible for the strategy, implementation, enhancement, and lifecycle management of business-critical applications supporting guest experience, ticketing, food & beverage, customer relationship management (CRM), loyalty, marketing, digital engagement, and enterprise operations at Jio World Centre. The role partners closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative technology solutions, lead digital transformation initiatives, manage application modernization projects (including AI enabled automations), and ensure secure, scalable, and highly available application ecosystems that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

**JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Manage the complete lifecycle of enterprise applications, including implementation, enhancements, upgrades, integrations, maintenance, and end-of-life planning.
* Lead the delivery of digital transformation initiatives and technical projects using Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall methodologies, ensuring delivery within approved scope, budget, quality, and timelines.
* Partner with business stakeholders across Marketing, Events, Ticketing, Food & Beverage, Guest Experience, Finance, and Operations to understand business needs and translate them into technology solutions.
* Develop application roadmaps, modernization strategies, and technology improvement plans aligned with organizational objectives.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and business continuity of all business-critical applications.
* Drive enterprise integration between applications such as POS, Ticketing, CRM, Loyalty, Payment Gateways, ERP, Mobile Applications, Digital Platforms, Marketing Automation, and third-party systems.
* Manage application releases, patch management, change requests, version control, and deployment activities while minimizing operational disruption.
* Establish and monitor application support governance through defined SLAs, KPIs, SOPs, dashboards, and service improvement initiatives.
* Lead incident, problem, change, release, and root cause analysis (RCA) activities to improve application stability and service quality.
* Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, OEMs, and managed service providers, ensuring contractual compliance, service excellence, and SLA adherence.
* Monitor application performance using Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and observability tools, proactively identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, enterprise information security policies, data privacy regulations, and secure application development practices.
* Maintain application architecture documents, integration specifications, technical documentation, disaster recovery procedures, and audit records.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI-enabled solutions, workflow optimization, and emerging digital technologies.
* Support capacity planning, infrastructure readiness, and technology preparedness for major events, exhibitions, performances, and business-critical operations.
* Conduct stakeholder reviews, governance meetings, vendor performance reviews, and project status updates to ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to application support teams while promoting continuous improvement and innovation.
* Deliver functional and technical training to business users to maximize adoption and effective utilization of enterprise applications.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, digital platforms, AI capabilities, cloud services, and industry best practices, recommending technology innovations that enhance business value and guest experience.

**COMPETENCIES & SKILLS:**

* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, application lifecycle management, system integrations, and modern digital platforms.
* Hands-on knowledge of enterprise applications and technologies such as POS, CRM, Loyalty, Ticketing, Payment Gateways, along with REST APIs, SOAP, OAuth/SSO, and enterprise integration methodologies.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP), DevOps practices, CI/CD, and application monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, or AppDynamics.
* Sound knowledge of IT service management, application support, release management, governance, cybersecurity best practices, and application modernization initiatives.
* Strong technical project management capabilities with experience in delivering multiple concurrent technology and digital transformation initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder management, vendor management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, event-driven environment while demonstrating strong leadership, planning, documentation, and governance capabilities.
* Exposure to AI usage and integration.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Certifications in Application Development technologies, Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum), or IT Service Management (ITIL) will be an added advantage.
* Cloud certifications (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and AI or Digital Transformation certifications are desirable.

**EXPERIENCE:**

* 9–12 years of relevant experience in enterprise application development and management, digital solutions, and technical project management.
* Experience in managing enterprise applications, system integrations, vendors, and digital transformation initiatives within large organizations.
* Experience in hospitality, convention centres, entertainment venues, retail, airports, or other customer-centric environments will be preferred.

title: L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer - Location - Mumbai
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer**

*Enterprise Backup • Commvault • DR/NDR • Data Protection*

**Position**

L2  Backup Administrator Engineer

**Experience**

5–10 Years

**Employment Type**

[Full-Time / Contract]

**Location**

Mumbai

**Primary Technology**

Commvault Backup & Recovery

**Preferred**

Veritas / Cloud Backup/Commvault

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Commvault, with additional knowledge of Veritas for migration activities.

The engineer will manage backup and recovery across virtual machines, physical servers, databases, Kubernetes, storage infrastructure, and enterprise applications, while supporting DR/NDR operations, backup migrations, restoration, capacity planning, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

2. Key Responsibilities

Backup Solution Design & Implementation

**•**
Design, implement, configure, and manage enterprise backup solutions for critical systems, applications, and databases.

**•**
Understand application and infrastructure requirements and design appropriate backup policies and protection strategies.

**•**
Build new backup environments/solutions from scratch based on business and technical requirements.

**•**
Perform workload onboarding and migration to new backup platforms with minimum business disruption.

**•**
Configure backup policies, schedules, retention, storage pools, deduplication, compression, and auxiliary copy requirements.

**•**
Ensure backup solutions meet defined RPO, RTO, retention, and business continuity requirements.

Commvault Administration

**•**
Administer and troubleshoot Commvault Backup & Recovery environments, including CommCell, MediaAgents, storage pools, deduplication databases, libraries, policies, and schedules.

**•**
Manage backup, restore, auxiliary copy, retention, and storage operations.

**•**
Monitor backup health, failed/pending jobs, storage utilization, deduplication, and overall environment performance.

**•**
Troubleshoot Commvault configuration, infrastructure, connectivity, and performance issues.

**•**
Raise and manage OEM/vendor support cases and coordinate resolution through closure.

**•**
Implement applicable Commvault security and hardening capabilities.

Backup Monitoring & Operations

**•**
Monitor backup operations and ensure successful completion within agreed SLAs.

**•**
Review daily backup reports and identify failed, missed, pending, or abnormal jobs.

**•**
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring backup failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**•**
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly backup operational reports and dashboards.

Backup Troubleshooting & Restoration

**•**
Handling incidents and complex backup-related technical issues.

**•**
Troubleshoot backup and restore failures across VMware/VMs, physical servers, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, and enterprise applications.

**•**
Perform file-level, VM-level, database-level, and application-level restoration.

**•**
Validate restoration integrity and prepare RCA/corrective action plans for major incidents.

Disaster Recovery – DR/NDR

**•**
Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.

**•**
Configure and maintain backup/replication copies at DR and NDR locations.

**•**
Enable backup protection for workloads migrated to DR and maintain required secondary copies.

**•**
Participate in DR drills, BCP exercises, and disaster recovery activities.

**•**
Validate restoration capability during DR drills and document observations and corrective actions.

Backup Migration

**•**
Plan and execute migration from legacy backup platforms to Commvault or other target platforms.

**•**
Support Veritas-to-Commvault workload migration.

**•**
Analyze existing policies, retention, storage consumption, and application dependencies before migration.

**•**
Validate successful backup and restoration after migration.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

**•**
Perform backup data sizing and capacity planning.

**•**
Monitor storage growth, deduplication ratios, compression, and retention consumption.

**•**
Optimize backup policies, storage utilization, backup windows, compression, deduplication, and auxiliary copy strategies.

Security & Compliance

**•**
Implement backup security and access controls as per organizational policies.

**•**
Support advanced Commvault security features and secure backup practices.

**•**
Support internal/external audits, including RBI and banking regulatory requirements where applicable.

**•**
Maintain audit evidence, backup reports, restoration records, policies, and governance documentation.

Documentation

**•**
Maintain up-to-date backup infrastructure and operational documentation.

**•**
Prepare Backup Architecture, Configuration, Policy Matrix, Backup/Restore SOPs, DR/NDR Configuration, Migration Plans, Health Check Reports, RCA documents, DR Drill documents, and Capacity Reports.

**•**
Update documentation after major configuration or infrastructure changes.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

**•**
Work with Application, Database, Server, Storage, Network, Security, and DR teams.

**•**
Understand application requirements and recommend suitable backup/recovery solutions.

**•**
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for complex issues and technical escalations.

**•**
Participate in change management, implementation planning, and technical reviews.

Extended & Major Incident Support

**•**
Handle complex and critical backup incidents independently.

**•**
Provide L3 support for major backup failures, data recovery issues, and infrastructure incidents.

**•**
Provide support during DR drills, migrations, planned maintenance, and major implementation activities during weekends/night shifts when required.

**•**
Leave/comp-off will be managed as per agreed organizational/customer terms and applicable policy.

Continuous Improvement

**•**
Prepare and implement a quarterly backup process improvement plan.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

**•**
Automate repetitive monitoring and operational activities where feasible.

**•**
Reduce recurring incidents through permanent corrective actions.

3. Mandatory Technical SkillsBackup Technologies

**•**
Strong hands-on experience with Commvault Backup & Recovery.

**•**
Enterprise backup administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, restore, retention, deduplication, compression, auxiliary copy, and capacity management.

Protected Workloads

**•**
VMware / Virtual Machines; Physical Servers; Linux; Windows; Solaris; Oracle; Microsoft SQL Server; PostgreSQL; MySQL; Kubernetes; Enterprise applications.

Storage & Infrastructure

**•**
Hands-on understanding of SAN, NAS, disk-based backup storage, backup repositories, storage capacity/performance, and deduplication storage.

**•**
Understanding of backup servers, MediaAgents, Fibre Channel, Ethernet networking, server hardware, and RAID concepts.

DR/NDR & Migration

**•**
Disaster Recovery concepts, secondary/replicated backup copies, DR/NDR architecture, DR drills, RPO/RTO, and restoration validation.

**•**
Experience migrating workloads from Veritas or other legacy platforms to Commvault.

4. Preferred Skills & CertificationsCertifications

**•**
Commvault certification.

**•**
Veritas Backup certification/experience.

**•**
Relevant cloud backup certification.

Additional Knowledge

**•**
Aws , GCP , Hitachi Vantara and Commvault backup technologies.

**•**
VMware and Kubernetes backup/recovery.

**•**
Backup security, ransomware protection, immutable backup, and air-gapped backup concepts.

**•**
Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall concepts, and required ports.

**•**
ITIL / ITSM processes and Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

5. QualificationsEducation

**•**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

**•**
5–10 years of experience in enterprise Backup Administration.

**•**
3+ years of hands-on Commvault experience preferred.

**•**
Experience in L2/L3 support, implementation, troubleshooting, migration, and DR operations.

6. Key CompetenciesProfessional Competencies

**•**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

**•**
Ability to perform RCA for complex technical issues.

**•**
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**•**
Ability to work independently at L2/L3 level.

**•**
Good documentation and reporting skills.

**•**
Ability to coordinate with multiple technical teams and vendors.

**•**
Ability to work under pressure during critical incidents and DR activities.

Job Description: PostgreSQL + Oracle Database Administrator

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with strong hands-on expertise in PostgreSQL and Oracle databases. The ideal candidate will be responsible for database installation, configuration, administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and troubleshooting to ensure database reliability, security, and optimal performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain PostgreSQL and Oracle database environments.
* Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and overall health.
* Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and index management.
* Manage database backups, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Configure and maintain high-availability and disaster recovery solutions.
* Perform database patching, upgrades, migrations, and version management.
* Monitor database logs and troubleshoot performance issues, failures, and connectivity problems.
* Manage database users, roles, privileges, authentication, and access controls.
* Ensure database security, data integrity, and compliance with organizational standards.
* Manage tablespaces, storage allocation, partitioning, and database growth.
* Support database replication, clustering, and failover configurations.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and development teams to resolve database-related issues.
* Automate routine database administration tasks using scripting and database utilities.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and database configuration records.
* Participate in production support, incident management, and root-cause analysis.

Mandatory Technical Skills

PostgreSQL Database Administration

* Strong hands-on experience in PostgreSQL installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with PostgreSQL backup and recovery using tools such as pg\_dump, pg\_restore, and pg\_basebackup.
* Knowledge of streaming replication, replication slots, and failover management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL performance tuning, query plans, indexing, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
* Understanding of vacuuming, autovacuum, WAL management, and database maintenance.
* Experience managing PostgreSQL users, roles, permissions, and security.
* Knowledge of high availability and disaster recovery solutions such as Patroni, where applicable.

Oracle Database Administration

* Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Database installation, configuration, administration, and maintenance.
* Experience with RMAN backup and recovery.
* Knowledge of Oracle performance tuning, SQL tuning, execution plans, and indexing.

description:

Sr DBA role.

Database migration from on premise to cloud (AWS). Expected to have an experience on Postgres migration. Specifically older version of Postgres to a newer version of Postgres.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
A Senior Database Engineer to own indexing strategy, query performance, and database architecture decisions across our PostgreSQL estate. You'll work on systems where scale is a given — large tables, high write volume, and workloads where a wrong indexing decision costs real money in latency and infrastructure spend. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you'll be trusted to make the trade-offs, not just execute someone else's spec.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and tune indexing strategies (B-Tree, GIN, GiST, Hash, BRIN, and partial/expression indexes) for large-scale production workloads
  
  
Diagnose and resolve query performance issues using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, planner statistics, and PostgreSQL internals knowledge
  
  
Evaluate trade-offs between read performance, write amplification, storage cost, and maintenance overhead when proposing schema or index changes
  
  
Partner with backend engineering teams to review schema designs, query patterns, and migrations before they hit production
  
  
Own database architecture decisions for new and evolving services — index strategy, partitioning, and data modelling at scale
  
  
Set and enforce best practices for index maintenance, auto vacuum tuning, and bloat management
  
  
Mentor other engineers on query optimization and PostgreSQL fundamentals
  
  
**Required**
**What We're Looking For**
Deep, hands-on experience with PostgreSQL internals — MVCC, the query planner, and how indexes are actually used (not just created)
  
  
Proven ability to design and reason about B-Tree, GIN, and GiST indexing strategies for real production workloads
  
  
Experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues on large (100M+ row) tables
  
  
Comfort with the trade-offs between different index types and knowing when not to add an index
  
  
Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to both an engineer and a stakeholder
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience with BRIN indexes on time-series or append-only data
  
  
Experience with jsonb/full-text search indexing at scale
  
  
Familiarity with exclusion constraints, range types, and PostGIS/spatial workloads
  
  
Experience tuning auto vacuum, WAL, and replication for high-write systems
  
  
Seniority & Experience
  
  
Senior-level role. We expect fundamentals to be a given — the real bar is applied judgment: can you reason through a genuinely ambiguous, large-scale trade-off and defend the decision, not just recite definitions.

**Position Overview**
The Application Support Analyst acts as an individual contributor within support, driving service excellence within the support organization through hands-on ticket work, demonstrating quality, ownership, and resolution pace. They handle day-to-day items submitted through the support portal, internal technical tasks and investigation, as well as client-facing communication as regards support items. This role contributes to ongoing improvement by owning documentation and identifying opportunities to streamline operations. Overall, the Application Support Analyst provides the backbone of the Loss Control support team’s technical ticket resolution capabilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as an individual contributor by maintaining active ticket ownership and demonstrating strong closure habits and quality expectations
* Provide first-line technical support for Duck Creek applications, responding to user inquiries and resolving incidents.
* Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, working to identify root causes and implement resolutions.
* Support day-to-day ticket operations, reduce backlog, and improve service delivery
* Escalate complex issues specialized departments when necessary.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions for future reference in support knowledge bases.
* Work with internal teams to identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions to improve system performance.
* Collaborate with application development and infrastructure teams to resolve issues and implement new features.
* Maintain response time, communication standards, and a professional approach to customer resolution
* Participate in training sessions and stay up to date on system updates, application changes, and new functionalities. Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  
Bullet list describing the education & experience to perform the role, including any certifications.
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in application support, IT operations, or a similar technical support role.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Duck Creek Technologies products or similar enterprise software.
* Knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.
* Experience in the insurance technology sector or related industries.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to resolve basic application issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively document incidents and collaborate with team members.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Understanding of IT environments, including basic networking, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.
* Ability to escalate complex issues and collaborate with senior staff to resolve them.
* Familiarity with enterprise software release cycles and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Customer-oriented mindset, focused on providing prompt and effective technical support.
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail in managing incident logs and troubleshooting steps.
* Ability to adapt to changing technologies and stay updated on new features and system enhancements.
* Basic knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies as they relate to application support.
* Ability to work independently and in a team, supporting larger initiatives and projects as needed.
* Analytical skills to evaluate performance trends and suggest improvements in application support processes.
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and development in application support best practices.

**Technical Competencies**

* SQL Server: Ability to perform basic queries (CRUD), understand database schemas and relationships between tables, and create or update stored procedures, functions, views, SQL Server Agent jobs, maintenance plans, and other SQL Server resources. Intermediate or above understanding of advanced SQL topics, including T-SQL, cursors, CTEs, temporary tables, joins, subqueries, transactions and error handling, indexing, query execution plans and performance analysis, XML querying, basic dynamic SQL, backups and restoration, and SQL tracing/profiling. Strong working knowledge of SQL Server Replication, including configuration and creation of replication, monitoring replication health, and troubleshooting/debugging replication failures, synchronization issues, and related data problems.
* Azure: Working knowledge of the Azure Portal and core services used to support applications, including Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory/AAD) including identity and access management, and Azure Key Vault. Ability to review configuration and logs, debug and troubleshoot application issues, connect to and query Azure SQL databases, perform basic tracing, monitor and troubleshoot Data Factory pipelines, and investigate authentication, access, and secret/configuration-related issues.
* Debugging and Troubleshooting: Ability to systematically investigate and isolate application, data, integration, and configuration issues using logs, error messages, stack traces, database queries, trace files, and other diagnostic information. Able to reproduce issues, identify root causes, distinguish application defects from configuration or data problems, and clearly document findings for escalation when required.
* IIS: Working knowledge of Internet Information Services (IIS), including websites, application pools, authentication, application configuration, log files, and a basic understanding of bindings. Ability to restart applications/application pools, review IIS and application logs, troubleshoot availability and connectivity issues, and diagnose common application pool, authentication, and configuration-related problems.
* SSO / SAML: Working knowledge of Single Sign-On (SSO) and SAML-based authentication, including identity provider and service provider concepts, SAML assertions, metadata, certificates, claims/attributes, and authentication flows. Ability to troubleshoot common SSO issues involving configuration, user access, claims, redirects, and failed authentication.
* API: Working knowledge of REST APIs and web services, including HTTP methods, endpoints, request/response formats, headers, authentication, status codes, and JSON/XML payloads. Ability to test and troubleshoot API calls using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI, review API documentation and request/response data, and diagnose common authentication, connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues.
* Other Technical Skills: Working knowledge of FTP/SFTP, XML/XSLT, and PowerShell. Ability to read, modify, and troubleshoot XML and XSLT; use PowerShell for basic scripting, automation, and troubleshooting; configure, test, and troubleshoot FTP/SFTP-based file transfers; and read and understand application code for troubleshooting purposes, including .NET, JET, HTML, JavaScript, and other relevant languages or technologies.

title: CloudOps Engineer (L2)
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support, incident resolution, and operational management across enterprise IT infrastructure. The role involves diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues, performing administration activities, implementing changes, supporting problem management, and mentoring L1 engineers while ensuring high service availability and SLA compliance.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Administration & Operations**

* Administer and maintain Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup and GPU infrastructure to ensure high availability and operational stability.
* Perform proactive health checks, capacity monitoring, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance activities.

**Advanced Incident Management**

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 2 infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and coordinate with L3 teams for permanent resolution.
* Review escalations from L1 teams and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Participate in Major Incident Management and support service restoration activities.

**Windows Server & Active Directory Administration**

* Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Services, and Windows services.
* Manage user accounts, organizational units, security groups, permissions, and authentication-related activities.
* Troubleshoot server performance, replication, authentication, and domain-related issues.

**Linux Administration**

* Perform Linux server administration, including user management, package management, service configuration, performance tuning, and security patching.
* Analyze system logs, troubleshoot kernel and OS issues, and optimize server performance.

**Virtualization Administration**

* Administer Cloud native/VMware/Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, snapshots, cloning, migration, and resource optimization.
* Monitor hypervisor performance and troubleshoot virtualization platform issues.

**Kubernetes Administration**

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including node management, workload deployment, pod lifecycle management, namespace administration, and cluster health monitoring.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource constraints, networking, and orchestration issues.

**Storage & Backup Administration**

* Administer enterprise storage systems, LUN provisioning, storage allocation, capacity management, and performance optimization.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions, perform backup validation, restore operations, and troubleshoot backup failures.

**GPU Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer GPU-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Monitor GPU utilization, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, perform firmware validation, and coordinate hardware replacement activities.

**Hardware & Data Center Support**

* Diagnose server hardware failures involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, power supplies, and network interfaces.
* Coordinate hardware replacements with vendors and perform post-maintenance validation.

**Change & Problem Management**

* Execute approved infrastructure changes following organizational change management processes.
* Participate in Problem Management by identifying recurring issues and implementing preventive actions.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor L1 engineers and contribute to operational excellence and automation initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Windows/Linux Administration, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, Kubernetes, Storage & Backup Administration, Network Operations, GPU Infrastructure Administration, Troubleshooting, Incident, Problem Management and Infrastructure Troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting mission – critical production environments with 24 x 7 operations
* 4–6 years of experience in Hardware Support, Change Management, Documentation, ITIL Processes, Vendor Coordination, Automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python), Operational Reporting, and Team Collaboration.
* Preferred Exposure: Experience working with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, cloud native virtualization platforms, VMware, Nutanix, Kubernetes/Openshift environments, cloud native storage, Enterprise storage like NetApp & HPE etc. Backup Solution like Commvault & Cloud native backup tools, enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Zoho etc. & ITSM Platform including Manage Engine & Service Now etc. and GPU infrastructure supporting AI/ML workload is preferred

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented

title: Database Administrator - IT Operations Management
description:
All Openings Database Administrator - IT Operations Management Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Job Summary**

The Database Administrator (DBA) will be responsible for the administration, security, performance, availability, and governance of the organization's database platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS RDS, and high-availability architectures, with Oracle exposure being an added advantage. The incumbent will own database operations, performance optimization, backup and recovery, disaster recovery readiness, security compliance, automation initiatives, and database infrastructure modernization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration & Performance Management**

* Administer, maintain, secure, and optimize SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS RDS, and Oracle databases.
* Manage database lifecycle activities including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning.
* Monitor database health, availability, resource utilization, query performance, indexing strategies, and capacity planning.
* Perform performance tuning, bottleneck analysis, execution plan reviews, and optimization of production, DR, UAT, and development environments.

**AWS RDS & Cloud Database Operations**

* Administer AWS RDS environments, including parameter groups, option groups, snapshots, backup policies, maintenance windows, security configurations, and storage management.
* Support on-premises to cloud migrations and optimize cloud database architectures for performance, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
* Drive AWS database cost optimization initiatives.

**Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery**

* Design and manage enterprise backup, recovery, retention, and archival strategies aligned to defined RPO/RTO objectives.
* Conduct restoration testing, backup validation, DR drills, failover testing, and recovery exercises.
* Manage replication, clustering, Always-On Availability Groups, log shipping, standby environments, and synchronization mechanisms.
* Maintain documentation, SOP, test reports, and operational readiness of DC and DR environments.

**Database Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Implement database security controls including access management, auditing, encryption, activity monitoring, privilege management, and hardening.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security reviews, compliance audits, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure adherence to organizational standards for data retention, data protection, and governance.

**Monitoring, Automation & Collaboration**

* Implement monitoring, alerts, dashboards, health reports, utilization reporting, and proactive risk management practices.
* Drive automation of routine database administration and maintenance activities.
* Support application deployments, upgrades, modernization projects, architecture reviews, and database migrations.
* Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and provide technical guidance to junior team members.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 5–8 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise database environments with high-availability requirements.
* Proven experience supporting cloud-hosted databases, particularly AWS RDS.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

Microsoft SQL Server • PostgreSQL • MySQL • AWS RDS • Database Performance Tuning • Query Optimization • High Availability & Disaster Recovery • Backup & Recovery • Replication Technologies • Database Security & Hardening • SQL Scripting & Stored Procedures • Capacity Planning • Database Monitoring • Database Migration & Upgrade Management • Windows & Linux Server Administration.

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**

**Skills:**
Oracle Database Administration, PowerShell/Shell/Python Automation, AWS Cloud Services, Infrastructure Monitoring Platforms, DevOps & CI/CD Concepts, Database Automation Tools.

**Certifications:**
Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, AWS Database Specialty/Associate, MySQL Administration, Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent.

**Core Competencies**

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, database performance engineering expertise, ownership mindset, operational excellence, incident management capability, documentation proficiency, stakeholder management, and proactive risk mitigation.

**Working Conditions**

Participation in database upgrades, migrations, DR exercises, maintenance windows, on-call support, critical incident response, and business continuity activities outside standard business hours may be required.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

description:

**Role Overview**
 We’re seeking a proactive
 **Database Administrator (DBA)** 
 to manage, optimize, and secure our PostgreSQL, Document DB, and analytical database ecosystems. You’ll design scalable architectures for multi\-tenant SaaS environments, implement advanced PostgreSQL extensions, and enforce robust security protocols. Your work will directly enhance the performance, reliability, and innovation of our AI\-driven data platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Database Management \& Optimization:**
* Administer and fine\-tune PostgreSQL clusters for high availability, replication, and query performance (indexing, partitioning, vacuum optimization).
* Explore, evaluate, and implement PostgreSQL extensions (e.g. TimescaleDB for time\-series, pg\_partman for partitioning, pg\_cron for job scheduling) to solve unique business needs.
* Manage Document DBs (MongoDB/Couchbase), including sharding, aggregation pipelines, and indexing strategies for big data workloads.
* Optimize analytical databases (ClickHouse, DuckDB) for fast query execution and large\-scale data aggregation.


**Security \& Compliance**
* Enforce security best practices: encryption (TDE, SSL), role\-based access control (RBAC).
* Implement row\-level security, data masking, and audit logging for sensitive data in multi\-tenant environments.
* Design and execute disaster recovery strategies (backups, point\-in\-time recovery, failover clusters).


**Multi\-Tenancy \& Scalability**
* Architect and manage multi\-tenant database architectures using schema isolation, tenant\-aware partitioning, or shared tables with tenant IDs.
* Ensure resource isolation and performance consistency across tenants in SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with developers to design tenant\-specific optimizations (e.g., dynamic data partitioning).


**Collaboration \& Innovation**
* Work with backend teams to optimize ORM queries, design efficient schemas, and integrate databases with Django/FastAPI.
* Partner with DevOps to automate deployments, scaling, and monitoring (Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus/Grafana).
* Research and prototype cutting\-edge database technologies (e.g., vector databases for AI/ML workloads).


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Database Administration experience, preferably in SaaS or big data environments.
* Expertise in PostgreSQL: query optimization, extensions, replication, and backup strategies.
* Proficiency in designing and securing multi\-tenant database architectures.
* Strong experience with Document DBs (MongoDB/Couchbase): sharding, indexing, and aggregation frameworks.
* Knowledge of security practices: encryption, RBAC, vulnerability mitigation (SQL injection, insecure APIs).
* Familiarity with analytical databases (ClickHouse, DuckDB) and cloud platforms (AWS RDS, Azure Database).
* Ability to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks in large datasets (10M\+ rows).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Certifications: PostgreSQL Professional Certification, MongoDB Certified DBA, or cloud DB certifications (AWS/Azure).
* Experience with PostgreSQL extensions (e.g., pg\_stat\_statements, Citus for distributed scaling).
* Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus).
* Scripting skills (Python, Bash) for automation and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible).
* Knowledge of DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes operators for stateful workloads).

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.
